Name: Move
Main Effect: You move a distance up to your **Movement Speed**: [[speed]] meters.

Name: Jump
Main Effect: You jump a distance up to your **Movement Speed**, [[speed]] meters, and a height equal to your own **height**.

Name: Climb
Main Effect:
You climb a vertical surface a distance up to **half your Movement Speed**.

Your Game Master might ask for a roll, depending on what you are climbing.

Name: Investigate
Main Effect:
While in combat, you attempt to ascertain the weakness or the strength of an enemy, or to find a weak point or a hazard in the place you are fighting in.

Make a **{mind}** {roll:mind} or **{instinct}** {roll:instinct} roll against an enemy entity’s **Grit**, or against an environment difficulty rating your Game Master sets.

On a success you learn something worth knowing: what could help you in this fight, or the strengths and the weaknesses of the foe.

Name: Interact
Main Effect:
You interact with an object or with your surroundings: opening a door, pulling a lever, picking something up off the floor.

What it costs in **Action Points** is the Game Master’s to set.

Name: Hide
Main Effect:
If no enemy has **line of sight** on you, you may attempt to hide with an **{instinct} roll** {roll:instinct} against the **Grit** of every enemy.

Every enemy whose **Grit** you beat loses sight of you.

On their turn they use {{Investigate}} to attempt to find you.

Name: Grapple
Main Effect:
You attempt to restrain an entity within your **reach**.

Make a **{physique} roll** {roll:physique} against the target’s **Reflex**.

On a success, the target is **grappled**.

Name: Shove
Main Effect:
You use force to push an entity **you can touch** away from you.

Make a **{physique} attack roll** {roll:physique} against the target.

On a hit, you push the target back **1.5 meters (3 feet)** or knock it **prone**.

Name: Anticipate
Main Effect:
You give up the initiative and wait on someone else instead.

Convert any number of **Action Points** into **Reaction Points**, one for one. Nothing is spent by this: the points move from one pool to the other, and no pool may pass its own maximum.

Name: Stabilize
Main Effect:
You attempt to stabilize a dying entity within your **reach**.

Make a **{mind} roll** {roll:mind} against the target’s negative **Health** divided by **5**.

On a success they are no longer dying and sit at **0 Health**. They remain **unconscious** until healed.

Name: Inventory
Main Effect:
You retrieve, stow or swap an item stored in your **pack**.

Items on your **belt** can be reached freely. Getting into your pack is what this action costs.
